RESEARCH.HEADING: Research & Strategy
RESEARCH.DESCRIPTION: Before starting development, I always make sure I know what needs to be done and what I need to learn to start on the right foot. Then comes the process of breaking down the work into atomic tasks and making sure the order and estimates of the tasks are perfect.

DESIGN.HEADING: Brainstorming & Design
DESIGN.DESCRIPTION: In this step, I take each atomic task and look for the best approach to tackle the problem. I discuss multiple ideas with team members and create a preliminary design for both front-end and back-end tasks.

DEV.HEADING: Development
DEV.DESCRIPTION: This step is about executing the atomic tasks established in the previous steps.

QA.HEADING: Quality
QA.DESCRIPTION: This step involves unit testing as well as integration testing of the functionality. I am still working on learning to write automated test cases.

T1.NAME: Luis Angel Flores

ABOUT.HEADING: About me
ABOUT.DESCRIPTION: Hello, I'm Héctor Adrián Román. I'm a Senior Full Stack Developer with over 3 years of experience working at the Government of Durango State (CETIC), specializing in complex government systems and enterprise applications development. My experience includes developing robust web applications using Java, Spring Boot, Angular, TypeScript and databases like Oracle and PostgreSQL. I have led monolithic architecture and microservices projects, implementing scalable solutions that handle thousands of concurrent users. I have experience in the entire software development lifecycle, from requirements analysis to production deployment, working with agile methodologies and CI/CD tools.

CONTACT.HEADING: Contact me
CONTACT.DESCRIPTION: Excited to work together on something. I'm always open to opportunities to learn something new every day. Let's connect!
